ra:2476147.title: 10SERIES by Shelter | TINS (all night)
ra:2476147.lineup_text:
Some all-nighters are built around a single artist's vision. August 29 belongs to TINS.
Tijn, the Amsterdam-based DJ and producer, takes the Shelter main room from open to close. A rare chance to hear an artist shape an entire night on their own terms. In the second area, Malindi and Kingdom Sound hold the floor.
And while you're at it, meet our new monthly initiative. Once a month, Shelter hosts a €10 night spotlighting a rising local artist with an all-night set or a full secret guest lineup. Giving the next generation a big stage and keeping the dance floor open to everyone.

ra:2506190.title: Vrijdag is NYX: International Beyoncé Day
ra:2506190.lineup_text:
ROOM 1: INTERNATIONAL BEYONCÉ DAY
The ultimate Beyoncé soundtrack.
Expect nothing but Beyoncé all night long. The biggest hits, fan favorites, deep cuts, live versions, remixes, iconic collaborations and dancefloor edits. Every album. Every era. Every mood.
From Crazy In Love to BREAK MY SOUL. From Formation to Texas Hold 'Em. If it's Beyoncé, we're playing it.
Music by:
Joshua Walter B2B Aiscream
Gaby Vineyard
Beyoncé performances by Vanity Vickers
ROOM 2: THE QUEENS, FRIENDS & INSPIRATIONS
The women who built the throne and the ones carrying it forward.
Dance through a celebration of iconic female artists connected to Beyoncé's world. Expect everything from Diana Ross, Tina Turner, Whitney Houston and Janet Jackson to Rihanna, Kelly Rowland, Ciara, Amerie, Victoria Monét, Doechii, SZA, Tinashe, Normani, Chlöe and many more.
A night filled with R&B, pop, hip hop and unforgettable diva energy.
Music by:
Soulfania
Shivi Grace
Yenoah
ROOM 3: CLUB RENAISSANCE
Where the ballroom comes alive.
Inspired by the culture behind RENAISSANCE, this floor celebrates ballroom, vogue, house and Black queer club culture. Expect runway-ready beats, ballroom anthems, house classics, bounce, Jersey Club and underground club sounds alongside Beyoncé edits inspired by the album that brought ballroom to the global stage.
This is for the dancers. The lovers. The community.
Music by:
Frandy Perez
SACHA

@nikkoaxzul
Nikko Axzul co-founded Jazz Club, one of Amsterdam's most interesting music collectives, and has spent his time behind the decks building a reputation for sets that seamlessly move across genres - Colombian and Mexican rhythms surfacing alongside sounds picked up during years spent in Los Angeles and New York. Raised in multicultural LA and shaped by time living in NYC, his music carries the fingerprints of every place he's called home. And that home is now Amsterdam.

ra:2547693.lineup_text:
Techno Dampfer Amsterdam w/ Anna Reusch
For nearly two decades, Anna Reusch has been one of the defining artists of the German techno scene. Her sound is characterized by driving grooves, intensity, and a distinct style—shaped by releases on renowned labels such as Drumcode, Tronic, and Arcane Records. Tracks like “Knocking, ” “Come With Me, ” and “Nasty” are played in club and festival sets worldwide and showcase her unmistakable, powerful techno style.
Born in Wiesbaden, she discovered her passion for DJing at the age of 15 and was touring throughout Germany shortly thereafter. After taking a deliberate creative break, she returned with a new vision and established herself as a fixture on Europe’s major festival and club stages.
Today, Anna Reusch is known for her high-energy, precise sets that are both emotional and uncompromisingly forward-driving—techno with character and nearly 20 years of experience behind the decks.
Amsterdam get ready for – Anna Reusch on the decks ⚓️🔥

Dizzi Geetha
JF.HECTOR
Dizzi Geetha is a DJ, producer, theatre maker, composer and multi-instrumentalist. Dizzi's music will be a hypnotising live set built around electronic percussion to set us up for the evening.
JF.HECTOR is a DJ and moving freely across (electronic club) music genres. His sets are built around feeling rather than genre.
Hypnotic techno, trance, UK garage, gqom, jungle, DnB, left field house, ambient electronics and familiar tracks can all exist in the same space.
He approaches the dance floor in waves: restrain and space flow into euphoria and release. "I love to let tension build up, dissolve, and find its way back in a different form."

ra:2554589.title: ADE: Eli Fola presents The Healing Scapes
ra:2554589.lineup_text:
For ADE, Nigerian-American artist, producer, saxophonist and DJ Eli Fola brings The Healing Scapes to The Stargate — an evolving live experience exploring the intersection of electronic music, ancestral wisdom and emotional wellbeing.
Moving fluidly between house, techno, ambient soundscapes, jazz improvisation and Yoruba rhythmic traditions, Eli combines live saxophone, electronic production and cinematic sound design to create performances that exist somewhere between dancefloor and meditation ritual.
Following a life-changing experience with his health in 2026, Eli’s artistic practice deepened into an exploration of sound as a catalyst for healing, reflection and transformation — creating immersive experiences that invite listeners to process, reconnect and be present.
With releases on labels including He.She.They Records, Armada Music, Mobilee Records and Global Underground, and performances across more than 35 countries, Eli brings this deeply personal sonic language to The Stargate for a special ADE experience.
